explanation: Ensemble Markov - This model evaluates an ensemble of multiple Markov Chains with varying state lengths, using a voting mechanism to generate robust signals. It operates with signal parameters such as state_set=[3, 4, 5, 6], lookback=300, min_samples_per_model=20, model_threshold=0.6, vote_mode=unanimous, ensemble_threshold=0.6, min_agreeing_models=2. To control risk, it halts trading after 3 consecutive daily losses, restricts to 6 max trades per day, and sets a daily stop loss at 4 units.
